title: Context delivery bypasses provider placement and loses explicit removal state
wanted_capability: One context lifecycle that preserves provider-specific roles and task ordering, and emits removals before forgetting the previously delivered dispatch scope and pins.
notes: Source audit at 7a20a8f8 against Codex 242c5ce0. Startup uses the typed instruction ledger while older placement tests populate user_instructions manually. Explicit --dispatch-context '{}' clears emitted baselines but keeps restored provider history. See design/bro-harness/agent-loop-context-audit-2026-09-11.md. No runtime reproduction or fixes claimed.
resolution_note: Addressed in the agent-loop repair campaign through 5c4ae748. Typed instruction delivery precedes tasks and follows the provider strategy; explicit dispatch clearing retains baselines until revocations are emitted; AGENTS.override precedence and dynamic replacement are implemented. Startup, resume, compaction, removal and immutable-generation regressions pass in the lane. See design/bro-harness/agent-loop-context-audit-2026-09-11.md repair follow-up.
